Priya S: Kicking off v3.2.1 rollout now — canary -> 50% at 14:00 PT. Planning to watch key metrics for 10m then promote. @Alex M can you be on standby for rollback? :eyes:
Alex M: On standby, ping me if p95 or error rate spikes. Which runbook are we following?
Priya S: Using /runbooks/deploy-v3 (section: canary+promote). Quick checklist: smoke latency, 5xx, embeddings sanity, rerank regressions.
Cheng: I'll run the smoke scripts: `./smoke/check_latency.sh`, `./smoke/check_5xx.sh`, and a sample-embedding run against prod-ish dataset. Will post pass/fail.
OpsBot: Deploy event: v3.2.1 canary start by Priya S — task id deploy-2225-canary-1.
Amal: Reminder: alert thresholds for this rollout — p95 latency >150ms or error rate >0.5% triggers immediate rollback.
Alex M: If we need rollback the command is `deploy rollback v3.2.0 --force`. I have access and will execute within the minute if flagged.
Cheng: Canary is up. Quick read: p50 +3% (expected), p95 stable at ~120ms, errors 0.07%. No 5xxs observed in the first 90s.
Tobias: Note — earlier embedding routing change caused tokenization spikes in a different rollout. Watch `embedding_throttle` and `kv_cache_miss` metrics for this one.
Priya S: Good call. Cheng, include those two metrics in your sweep.
Cheng: Added them. Running sample prompts now. One rerank test showing 220ms (baseline 80ms) on a small subset — opening a tinyfix PR to reduce extra scoring overhead.
Alex M: Copy. If rerank regression holds at scale, we should consider rolling back. I'll stay ready.
Priya S: Promoting to 100% in 2m if no other red flags.
OpsBot: Promotion action: canary -> 100% initiated by Priya S.
Cheng: Promote done. Quick post-promote sanity: chat flow OK, embeddings lookup within normal range, rerank slow-case reduced after PR patch — now ~110ms on the sample.
Priya S: Patch merged and hot restart of the routing layer applied to pick up fix. Monitoring 10m.
Amal: Watching alerts. No SLA blips so far.
Alex M: Still on call. Ready to rollback if alerts cross thresholds.
Cheng: 10m check: p95 stable, errors low, embedding_throttle unchanged. Rerank tests are back in acceptable range. No rollback needed.
Priya S: Sweet — closing handoff. Thanks team for the quick response and the tinyfix. :tada: 
OpsBot: Deploy complete: v3.2.1 at 100% — closed deploy-2225-canary-1.
Cheng: Logging final notes in the release ticket (TICKET-4582) and adding the smoke output snippets.
Priya S: Great — I'll mark post-deploy verified.
